caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally within a rectangular border on a lightly colored background. The chair features four brown legs and a matching brown arched backrest that is straight and horizontal. The seat of the chair is upholstered with a bright red fabric and bordered with red decorative trim. No additional objects are present, and the drawing is limited to neutral beige tones for the background and border. The chair is illustrated at a slight angle, showing both the front and one side with a clear view of the structure and upholstery. There is a small signature or inscription in the bottom right corner within the bordered area.
title: Doll Chair
